newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fuji Bank HK completes HK$1.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank HK completes HK$1.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: Fuji Bank's HK$1.0 billion floating rate certificates of deposit (FRCD) issue has closed oversubscribed, arranger and lead manager Fuji International Finance (HK) said on Friday.
The issue drew HK$2 billion in applications, but was not increased in size, the arranger said.
The two-year issue, launched through the bank's Hong Kong branch, was priced at par at 25 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 28 basis points.
The issue was made from the bank's HK$5.0 billion CD programme.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility, or discount window.
Arranger and lead manager Fuji International Finance (HK) committed to HK$220 million.

Co-lead managers, with HK$30 million each, are Banca Commerciale Italiana's Hongkong branch, Bayerische Landesbank's Hong Kong branch, China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong), Commerz (East Asia), Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Dao Heng Bank, DKB Asia, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, HSBC Markets, IBJ Asia, ING Barings, Jardine Fleming Bank, LTCB Asia, Paribas Asia, Peregrine Fixed Income, Royal Bank of Scotland, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance, Societe Generale Asia, Standard Chartered Bank, Sumitomo Finance (Asia), Tokai Asia, Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK), Union Bank of Switzerland's Hong Kong branch, Westdeutsche Landesbank and Westpac Banking Corp's Hong Kong branch.
Signing is set for June 10. The payment date is June 23.
